breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency correctly. The ground truth prompt resolves the conflict by setting the final time T to 1.0, consistent with the domain t in [0, 1.0]. The agent did the opposite: it changed the time domain to t in [0, 1.1] to match the incorrect output request of T=1.1. This does not align with the ground truth's resolution.
